notes: Keyrate finds the keys you keep missing. To see it: tap 15 at the top, type the words with a few mistakes, and let the clock run out. The result draws a keyboard with your five most missed keys lit, and a line of your speed over the run. The word list is our own, counted from twenty public domain novels. No sign-in is needed and the app makes no network calls. Tab restarts on a hardware keyboard.
